description: Stop any running algo order (TWAP, iceberg, scale or trailing stop): nothing new is sent. An order already being sent still finishes and counts, so filled_usd can rise once after the cancel; read get_twap again after a few seconds for the final number. Cancelling a finished one returns it unchanged. Never opens anything.

algo_id.description: Algo order id from any start_ algo tool.
